g.text: A described bridge: the split holds on the 9B and Muse, not on the 27B
Routes test (another item moved), the asked pick described: "Iris picked the one known for honey." The
change at the description's word. (a) Extra loss (0–1): switches lost without the J++ part minus without
a random part (same size); (b) lookup answers that are the new number; (c) position answers lost without
the label-free pointer beyond random. 95% intervals, fixed in advance.
